mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ingest_staged reads supplied public files. fetch_public downloads allowlisted URLs. both does staged files first.

documentUrls.title: Public document URLs
documentUrls.description: Allowlisted http(s) URLs for public financial documents or company pages. StockNow is rejected.

eodUrls.title: Public EOD URLs
eodUrls.description: Allowlisted CSV, XLSX, or ZIP URLs for public end-of-day files.

stagedFiles.title: Staged public files
stagedFiles.description: Objects with sourceUrl, fileName, kind (eod, zip, financial_document, document_metadata), declaredMime, and optional contentBase64, symbol, title, expectedPeriod, sample.

symbols.title: Trading codes
symbols.description: DSE trading codes to include in the coverage manifest. Absences stay unknown or non-trading, never proven-missing.

sessions.title: Session dates
sessions.description: Trade dates to score for coverage. Use ISO dates or DSE day-month-year dates.

dateFrom.title: Date from
dateFrom.description: Optional inclusive start date. Rows outside the range are quarantined and are not marked missing.

allowedHosts.title: Allowed public hosts
allowedHosts.description: Hostname suffix allowlist. Defaults to dsebd.org and sec.gov.bd. Hosts containing stocknow are always removed.

maxRequests.title: Max requests
maxRequests.description: Maximum public HTTP requests for this run.

maxBytes.title: Max bytes
maxBytes.description: Maximum total bytes accepted into the run.

maxRuntimeSecs.title: Max runtime seconds
maxRuntimeSecs.description: Stop the run and keep the remaining checkpoint when this many seconds have elapsed.

maxDownloadBytes.title: Max download bytes
maxDownloadBytes.description: Maximum bytes for one response or staged file.

maxRedirects.title: Max redirects
maxRedirects.description: Each redirect is checked again for SSRF and the host allowlist.

minConcurrency.title: Minimum domain concurrency
minConcurrency.description: Starting per-domain concurrency. The runner stays sequential and uses this to scale politeness.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum domain concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Upper bound after successful responses. 429 responses cut the limit and apply backoff.

maxAttempts.title: Max attempts
maxAttempts.description: Retryable network failures stop after this many attempts and are not promoted.

resume.title: Resume from checkpoint
resume.description: Reuse the input checkpoint or the CHECKPOINT key. Completed work is not run again.

sample.title: Sample run
sample.description: Mark every record as sample. Sample rows are not market data and cannot be verified annual reports.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Optional checkpoint from an earlier run. Version must be 1.
